blurb: Guests rent various boats including fishing boats, pontoon boats, wakeboard boats, and Chaparral boats for leisure and water sports on Lake Berryessa. Kayak and stand-up paddleboard rentals are also available. Accessories like wakeboards, tubes, and skis can be rented to enhance the water experience.
